description: Click a UI element by element_index (from mac_ax_state / mac_find; valid 30 s) or at raw {x,y}. With element_index the element is re-identified first (element_no_longer_valid if gone or changed). mechanism auto (default): its own accessibility action (press / show menu / select — no pointer, no focus change, works in background windows) when it has one, else a physical click that is sent only if a hit test shows the point reaches the element (occluded otherwise); semantic / physical force one path. count 2-3 and button middle are physical. A physical click is re-checked right before it is sent, and is delivered_verified only if the element is still there, changed, and its window is still on top at the point. A raw {x,y} click is sent only when the window on top at that point belongs to app (default: the frontmost app; the menu bar counts as the frontmost app's) — otherwise occluded names what covers it and nothing is sent; force:true skips that check. Results state delivery (delivered_verified / delivered_unverified / not_delivered / unknown) and whether a retry is safe, plus newly opened sheets, dialogs or menus.
name: mac_click
